name: Michelin (Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin)
note: Parent group of the Kleber tire brand (kleber-michelin-ownership, michelin-multibrand) and owner of the Michelin brand. Organized as a partnership limited by shares (SCA) since 1951; per its 2025 Universal Registration Document, as of 31 December 2025 BlackRock held 6.12% of the share capital, Capital Group 5.07% and Mage Invest 4.41%, and no other shareholder directly or indirectly holds more than 5%; the same section also records that Capital Group crossed 10% of the share capital on 17 March 2026 (AMF notice ref. 226C0343).
